ui.title: Title
ui.desc: a manga adaptation of the Bible.
ui.lede: The Bible as a full-color manga — one volume per book of the Bible, every scene and every line of dialogue in the words of the {c}. Now in progress: {v}.
ui.meta: The Bible as a full-color manga, in the style of 1980s cyberpunk comics, in the words of the {c}.
ui.text_lede: The manga quotes the {c} word for word. Here is the whole text, Genesis to Revelation, one PDF per book: two columns, a bookmark for every chapter. The {c} credit at the foot of every manga page opens its book at that page's chapter.

words.sub: The text of the Bible Manga
words.lead: Every book and chapter is a link. The PDF's bookmarks list them too.
words.title: The Holy Bible
words.colophon: {c} · public domain. Set from the USFM text published by eBible.org, with the Strong's numbers taken out. Words the translators supplied are in italics, as in the printed edition; the few textual notes stand at the end of their chapter. Every word of the Bible Manga is cut from this text.
